$comment: Hand-maintained. Facts about a model that Revana states ONLY in its API's own 422 messages — absent from GET /v1/models and from the OpenAPI document (whose ModelInput declares no speech field at all). Each entry quotes the message it was read from, verbatim, with the date. Collected from POST /v1/generations/quote, which validates the same body as a create and is free.

elevenlabs-multilingual-v2.quote: elevenlabs-multilingual-v2 reads text aloud and does not take input.image_url. It takes text, voice, stability, similarity_boost, speed and language_code.

elevenlabs-turbo-2.5.quote: elevenlabs-turbo-2.5 reads text aloud and does not take input.image_url. It takes text, voice, stability, similarity_boost, speed and language_code.

elevenlabs-v3.quote: elevenlabs-v3 reads text aloud and does not take input.image_url. It takes text, voice, dialogue, stability and language_code.

elevenlabs-v4.quote: elevenlabs-v4 reads text aloud and does not take input.image_url. It takes text, voice, stability, similarity_boost, speed and language_code.

negativePrompt.quote: No route for veo-3.1 can take this input (cannot take negative_prompt).
negativePrompt.source: POST https://api.revana.si/v1/generations/quote, asked of every ModelInput model; the two listed priced the request and each of the others answered the quoted sentence with its own id
